messages:
marta: Quick alert  netSuite backfill run created clashing external_ids for invoice_adjustments, which caused 4 prior adjustments to be overwritten in NetSuite. Not a duplicate credit, but replacement of audit lines.

kevin: Wait, overwritten? That's bad for audit. Which backfill? The weekend targeted usage rewindow?

marta: Yes, the rewindow backfill we ran to fix a late-arrival attribution issue (run_id=bf_2026_11_02). The backfill script generated external_id using `format('%s-%s', customer_id, floor(now/60))` which only has 1-minute resolution. Multiple adjustments for the same customer in the same minute produced identical external_id.

kevin: Oof. I remember that pattern from a quick patch. NetSuite upsert by external_id overwrites existing records. Any affected customers with posted invoices?

sophia_fin: How many customers and what's the monetary exposure? Also audit impact: overwritten records lose original created_by info.

marta: Tally: 4 customers affected, 2 had already posted adjustments; overwritten entries removed original creator info and replaced amounts. Gross delta ~ $610 across the four. Exported CSV to internal: https://redwood.internal/fin/backfill-externalid-collision (private).

lee_ops: Root cause confirmed: unstable external_id generator + NetSuite upsert behavior. Quick mitigation: add unique suffix (UUID) to external_id for backfill runs and mark existing overwritten items with a memo note to preserve history.

eng-bot: backfill-run status 2026-11-02T03:12:00Z - run_id=bf_2026_11_02 processed_adjustments=98 collisions_detected=4

kevin: Plan: (1) hotfix backfill tool to use deterministic but unique external_ids (customerid + eventid + backfill-run-id) so we can idempotently reference the exact event, (2) create a reconciliation job to restore original adjustments from our audit log where overwritten, (3) add preflight check to detect external_id collisions before pushing to NetSuite. Assigning tasks: kevin=hotfix, marta=reconcile+validation, sophia_fin=finance review + comms.

marta: I'll start the reconcile script. We have full history in the internal ledger; can reconstruct original adjustment metadata and push compensating notes rather than silently changing records.

sophia_fin: Please hold on customer notifications until reconcile completes. If we need to issue memos/credits we'll prepare language. Also tag sales for enterprise accounts.

eng-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/fin-inc/pull/745 "backfill: use event-scoped external_id and preflight collision check" 

kevin: PTAL: change is to external_id = sha1(concat(customer_id, stripe_event_id, backfill_run_id)). Also added `--dry-run-preflight` that simulates NetSuite dedupe and reports collisions.

lee_ops: Added a NetSuite-side mitigation: when a write would overwrite an item and audit fields differ, write a related memo preserving previous external_id and old created_by in a note. This keeps a human-readable trail.

eng-bot: CI passed for pr-745 at 2026-11-02T07:20:15Z. unit=ok integration=ok

kevin: Deployed pr-745 to staging. Running preflight: `./tools/backfill --since 2026-10-30 --until 2026-11-02 --preflight --run-id=bf_2026_11_02`

marta: Preflight shows 0 collisions with new external_id scheme. Good. Will run dry-run reconcile to reconstruct originals and create compensating notes in staging.

backfill-bot: reconcile-dryrun completed 2026-11-02T23:40:00Z - to_restore=4 potential_notes=4 duplicates_found=0

kevin: Scheduling live reconcile 2026-11-03T01:00Z. Command: `./tools/reconcile_overwrites --run bf_2026_11_02 --live --only-affected`

marta: Live reconcile finished 2026-11-03T01:22Z - restored original adjustments as compensating memos for 4 customers, did not reissue monetary credits. Finance checks show net exposure normalized; two invoices flagged for manual memo but amounts small. Posting final CSV to internal link.

sophia_fin: Finance validated the reconciliations. We'll absorb the small memo adjustments and include a note in the monthly billing bulletin. No direct customer notices needed. Please add alert `billing.backfill_externalid_collision > 0` to Datadog and add preflight to all backfill runbooks.

kevin: Follow-ups: (1) enforce external_id uniqueness in backfill tooling, (2) add preflight as default for any backfill, (3) update runbook to include manual steps if collisions are found. Filing FIN-938 for the postmortem.

marta: Thanks team. Learned lesson: never use time-truncated generator for idempotency keys. :white_check_mark:

lee_ops: Closing loop. Deployed fixes to prod-canary at 2026-11-03T02:10Z. smoke passed.

sophia_fin: Thanks all. I'll draft a short root-cause note for finance records and link FIN-938.
